author: /root/edge_paths
method: Read all complete authored items and compare underlying actions and visual motifs across fields. Consolidate category/material/colour/location variants; retain distinct functional mechanisms and geometries. Additional complete scenario replacements are recorded separately.

additionalMultiLabelGroups.reason: Both the reversed sleeve cuff and opened skirt expose a contrasting inner surface. The original construction motifs remain labelled too.
Pin placement is additionally substantive in these leaf-embroidery items.

annotationOnlyRename.previous: Shirt hem tied behind instead of front

preservedBoundaries: Raised fabric bobbles and a single knitted cable describe different surface geometries; broad raised-texture category alone does not merge them.
Fixed pleats, elastic smocking and a tied sleeve band use different structural mechanisms and create different forms.
The soft inner bag divider groups were consolidated; a rigid divider supporting a clutch upright remains a different support function.
Paper garment support, a washable shoe barrier and a hat travel case serve different specific support or hygiene functions.
Lace overlay and a lace inset have different layer structures. The additional lace hem group was wholly replaced.
Thread-chain lining tethers, facing stitches and lining clearance at a zipper address distinct constructions and functions.
